name: Munawla Cargo Co. Ltd.
summary: Munawla Cargo Co. Ltd. is a prominent provider of comprehensive logistics services, operating throughout the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Its extensive suite of offerings covers a wide array of solutions, including specialized project logistics, efficient freight forwarding, terminal operations management, diverse transportation options (including air freight), warehousing and distribution, and dedicated shipping agency services. Established in 1997, the company maintains its headquarters in Dammam, Saudi Arabia.
